title: Form 7B-Gamma
logline: An independent mining rig is trapped in a multi-year tax audit that costs more to comply with than the rig actually produces.

roles.description: Has not slept a full night in three years due to the constant demands of the audit.
A low-level clerk who derives immense personal power from finding rounding errors.
A rusty, barely functional extraction platform held together by stress and tape.
A faceless bureaucracy that measures success purely by fines collected.

public_situation: The {role:revenue_service} has placed a total freeze on the accounts of a local {role:mining_rig} pending a comprehensive historic audit.
private_truth: The auditor knows the miner is innocent, but the audit itself generates massive fees for the auditor's department, incentivizing them to drag it out forever.

beats.public_change: The revenue service demands a massive physical extraction quota to pay the monthly 'audit maintenance fee'.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to mine and deliver raw silicate so the rig can process it into construction materials to pay the immediate fine.
missions.private_fact: The miner is quietly selling off pieces of their own life support system to afford the fuel.

beats.public_change: The auditor announces they require physical copies of a highly specific, obsolete tax form cartridge.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to hunt down the obsolete data cartridges on the open market to save the rig from immediate default.
missions.private_fact: The auditor specifically chose a cartridge format that hasn't been manufactured in twenty years.

beats.public_change: The auditor personally arrives at the rig for a final, on-site emissions check.

missions.reason: Begs the pilot to scan the rig's emissions and verify they match the archaic standards on the newly acquired forms.
missions.private_fact: The miner has intentionally miscalibrated the sensors; if the pilot reports the true reading, the rig is seized.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot falsifies the scan to match the forms.
resolutions.summary: The audit is finally closed. The miner keeps their rig, but is deeply traumatized and in severe debt to the pilot.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a desperate miner forge their way out of a three-year tax audit.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reports a bureaucratic error that invalidates the audit.
resolutions.summary: The revenue service throws the auditor under the bus to save face. The auditor is fired, and the miner is entirely exonerated.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reports the true emissions violation.
resolutions.summary: The rig is immediately seized by the state. The miner is ruined and evicted, and the auditor gets a promotion.

loose_threads.detail: The automated targeting algorithm that flagged the miner was quietly updated three years ago by a defunct shell corporation.
The auditor obsessively checks their own personal credit score during conversations, muttering about 'the interest'.

radio_hooks: {role:revenue_service} announces new initiative to aggressively close 'historic accounting irregularities'.
Another independent rig defaults on compliance fees in {system}.

voice_direction.exhausted_miner: Breathy, disjointed sentence structure. Constantly repeats the last word of a sentence to reassure themselves.
voice_direction.relentless_auditor: Fast, flat, nasal rhythm. Drops prepositions. Overuses the word 'statutory'.
